html:
Unique Research · Event signup · March 14, 2024

Early 2024 stacked U.S. AI “king hits”: Google’s Gemini, OpenAI’s Sora text-to-video, and a forthcoming more socially aware ChatGPT-5. Generative AI is landing across transport, housing, food, and daily life — a new AGI scramble. That speed also fuels debate: is this only a giants’ game, or can next-gen AI startups co-build? Do Sora/Gemini rewrite startup and investment logic? Where should China’s AI go next?

At the 2024 Two Sessions, Premier Li Qiang’s government work report called for deeper big-data and AI R&D/application, an “AI+” action, and internationally competitive digital industry clusters.

Unique Research 2023 Global AIGC Industry Annual: China AI financing ¥19.18B — only ~10% of global AIGC financing ¥190.2B, and less than one-third of OpenAI’s alone (¥70.58B). China has the conditions; the ceiling is still high — and the U.S. remains the best field trip.

Hence Unique’s China–U.S. AI study camp: Seattle–Silicon Valley, May 12–20, 2024.

What you get

  1. Travel with multiple AI company founders
  2. Visit frontier AI products at OpenAI, Microsoft, Google, NVIDIA and peers
  3. Talk 0→1 product build, ML, and algorithms with HQ builders
  4. Exchange China–U.S. AI tech and application landing status/trends
  5. Join a Silicon Valley AI investment demo day — U.S. AI financing logic and opportunity
  6. Visit Stanford, UC Berkeley and other top universities for latest AI research

Route highlights

  • OpenAI — Sora, GPT series, DALL·E, Whisper, etc.
  • Microsoft (Redmond HQ) — FY2023 revenue $211.915B; Nov 2023 Altman & Brockman briefly joined Microsoft AI; Jan 24, 2024 market cap hit $3T (2nd after Apple)
  • Google — FY2022 revenue $282.8B; Dec 6, 2023 Gemini Ultra / Pro / Nano
  • Amazon / Amazon Q — Sep 25, 2023 Anthropic investment $4B (~¥28B); Nov 29 Amazon Q genAI assistant for enterprise content/search/summary
  • FlashIntel — AGI-driven GTM intel (founded 2022); 7 offices / 6 countries; 100+ eng/scientist/GTM; 3,000+ partners; FlashInfo + FlashClick; $10M seed (Celtic House, Uphonest, Hat-Trick); Silicon Valley Review “50 Most Admired 2023”
  • Pika Labs — founded Apr 2023 (4 people); Pika 1.0 (Nov 29, 2023) text/image/video → 3D/anime/cartoon/cinema video
  • Silicon Valley AI pitch day — founders ↔ investors under AGI scramble
  • Stanford — QS 2024 #5; SLAC / Hoover adjacency
  • UC Berkeley — QS 2024 #10; “public Ivy”
  • Culture: Space Needle, Boeing museum, first Starbucks, fireside chats, city walks

13 CN images (incl. itinerary boards); attach on ingest. No signup URL invented.

— END —
